description: This is a source code file implementing API endpoints for managing user files, including listing, uploading, deleting, and pinning files. It interacts with a Supabase backend, handles file storage, metadata, text extraction, embedding, and indexing into Chroma.

methods.name: get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client using environment variables for configuration.

methods.name: list_files(user=Depends(get_current_user), session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by session ID"))
methods.description: Lists files owned by the current user, optionally filtered by session ID.

methods.name: upload_file(user=Depends(get_current_user), session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None), f: UploadFile = File(...))
methods.description: Uploads a file, storing it in Supabase Storage, recording metadata, extracting and embedding text, indexing into Chroma, and logging the upload.

methods.name: delete_file(file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a specified file and its associated storage and metadata.

methods.name: pin_file(file_id: str, payload: FilePinRequest, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Pins or unpins a file to a session, updating its metadata.

ctags.name: list_files
ctags.signature: (user=Depends(get_current_user), session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by session ID"))

ctags.name: upload_file
ctags.signature: (user=Depends(get_current_user), session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None), f: UploadFile = File(...))
